baseline_prerequisites.notes: gen_random_uuid() must be callable on disposable target; baseline does not CREATE EXTENSION

constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (thread_id) REFERENCES consult_threads(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (assistant_message_id) REFERENCES consult_messages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (consult_thread_id) REFERENCES consult_threads(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (user_message_id) REFERENCES consult_messages(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (wallet_id) REFERENCES reply_ticket_wallets(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
CHECK ((payload_json ->> 'version'::text) IS NOT NULL AND (payload_json ->> 'version'::text) = version)
CHECK ((payload_json ->> 'theme'::text) IS NOT NULL AND (payload_json ->> 'theme'::text) = theme)
FOREIGN KEY (reply_session_id) REFERENCES reply_sessions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (reply_session_id, theme) REFERENCES reply_sessions(id, theme) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (consult_commit_id) REFERENCES consult_send_commits(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

CHECK (event_type = 'reply_consume'::text AND delta < 0 AND (reply_session_id IS NOT NULL OR consult_commit_id IS NOT NULL) OR (event_type = ANY (ARRAY['included_grant'::text, 'purchase_grant'::text])) AND delta > 0 OR (event_type = ANY (ARRAY['recovery_adjust'::text, 'admin_adjust'::text])))
FOREIGN KEY (reply_session_id) REFERENCES reply_sessions(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
FOREIGN KEY (wallet_id) REFERENCES reply_ticket_wallets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
